title: DynamicPartitioningConfiguration

allOf.description: The retry behavior in case Kinesis Data Firehose is unable to deliver data to an Amazon S3 prefix.
Specifies that the dynamic partitioning is enabled for this Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream.

description: The configuration of the dynamic partitioning mechanism that creates smaller data sets from the streaming data by partitioning it based on partition keys. Currently, dynamic partitioning is only supported for Amazon S3 destinations.
